business_summary: Suruga Bank Ltd. provides various banking and financial products and services to individuals and corporate customers in Japan. The company offers deposit products, such as time, non-interest bearing, savings, foreign currency, and other deposits, as well as current and general accounts; property, card, housing, second house, startup, and business up term loans, as well as loans by purpose; credit and debit cards; overdrafts; and other financing products. It also provides investment trust, public bond, pension contribution, insurance, inheritance/trust, lottery, foreign currency, pay-easy, web direct, safe deposit box, external linkage, remittance service, fund management, e-combination, payment, nursing care/medical care/dispensing compensation receivable factoring, mortgage, and internet and telephone banking services. In addition, the company offers money lending, guarantee, printing, leasing, and agency services, as well as advisory and consulting services. Suruga Bank Ltd. company was incorporated in 1895 and is headquartered in Numazu, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Suruga Bank Ltd.는 일본의 개인 및 기업 고객에게 다양한 은행 및 금융 상품과 서비스를 제공합니다. 회사는 당좌예금과 일반예금뿐만 아니라 정기예금, 무이자예금, 저축예금, 외화예금, 기타예금 등의 예금상품을 제공합니다. 부동산, 카드, 주택, 세컨드하우스, 창업, 창업 및 사업기한 대출 및 목적별 대출; 신용카드 및 직불카드; 초과인월; 및 기타 금융 상품. 또한, 투자신탁, 공채, 연금기여, 보험, 상속/신탁, 복권, 외화, 페이이지, 웹 다이렉트, 대여금고, 외부연계, 송금서비스, 자금관리, 전자결합, 지급결제, 요양/의료/보상채권 팩토링, 모기지, 인터넷 및 텔레뱅킹 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한, 자금대출, 보증, 인쇄, 임대, 대행 서비스와 자문 및 컨설팅 서비스도 제공하고 있습니다. Suruga Bank Ltd. 회사는 1895년에 설립되었으며 일본 누마즈에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
